newsitem.title: USA: General Motors declares unchanged dividends.
newsitem.headline: General Motors declares unchanged dividends.

text.p: General Motors Corp said Monday it declared an unchanged quarterly dividend of $0.50 a share on its $1-2/3 par value common stock, payable September 10 to shareholders of record on August 14.
It also declared an unchanged dividend of $0.25 a share on its class H common stock, also payable September 10 to holders of record on August 14.

"We'll continue to review the dividend rate quarterly, keeping in mind that our priority here is to provide GM shareholders with a competitive dividend that is sustainable throughout the business cycle," John Smith Jr, chairman, said in a statement.
Earlier today, GM said it would repurchase an additional $2.5 billion in common stock.

GM had 721.4 milion shares of $1-2/3 common stock at the close of the second quarter, down from 756 million shares at the end of 1996. The 4.6 percent reduction was attributed to stock repurchased since January through open market transactions.
